name: Human Respiratory System & Alveoli Cluster
semanticDescription: Medical-grade anatomical human respiratory system model showing hyoid bone arch, thyroid cartilage with laryngeal prominence (Adam's apple) and cornua, cricoid cartilage signet ring, epiglottis, trachea with 14 authentic C-shaped hyaline cartilaginous rings and posterior trachealis muscle, carina bifurcation, lobar and segmental bronchial tree arborization, anatomically contoured dual lungs (3-lobed right lung, 2-lobed left lung with cardiac notch), dome-shaped diaphragm with central tendon, and magnified alveolar sac cluster with pulmonary microvasculature (CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 5 Figure 5.9; CBSE Class 11 Biology Ch 17 Figure 17.1).
simplifications: Lung parenchyma modeled with optical dielectric transmission to reveal the interior bronchial tree arborization.
Bronchial branching visualized through primary, secondary lobar, and tertiary segmental bronchioles.
